# Matheus Abrahão — Full Bio and Work History

> Senior Software Engineer and Shopify Operator with 5+ years of experience scaling production-grade e-commerce ecosystems for international brands. Apple Swift Student Challenge 2026 Winner. Based in São Paulo, Brazil; works remotely worldwide.

Last updated: 2026-05-02.

---

## Origin Story

My first line of code was a C++ mod for a Rainbow Six Siege videogame. I was 14, had no idea what I was doing, and couldn't stop. That feeling — making a machine do exactly what I wanted — never went away.

By 16, I was building websites for clients. But I didn't just want to write code; I wanted to see how technical architecture drives real business. So, I founded my own e-commerce brand, Martin. I built the entire technical stack from scratch, ran the marketing, and operated the business end-to-end, generating over $90,000 in sales.

That experience shifted my entire career. It taught me how to think like an operator and a founder, making engineering decisions based on direct, measurable impact.

Today, I bring that same end-to-end ownership to international brands. As a Senior Software Engineer and Shopify Operator at Scale Army, I design, implement, and scale production-grade e-commerce ecosystems — specializing in complex catalog data management, technical SEO, and system automation for high-volume B2B and B2C environments.

## Work Experience

### Senior Shopify Operator — Scale Army
**May 2026 – Present · Charlotte, NC, United States · Remote · Full-time**

Leading complex Shopify operations, technical SEO, and data management for high-volume B2B and B2C environments.

- Catalog & data management: bulk updates, pricing adjustments, and inventory synchronization across multi-level variant configurations using Matrixify and complex CSV workflows.
- Technical SEO & performance: managing structured data, schema markup, and site architecture to ensure high crawlability and readiness for AI-powered search environments.
- Analytics & strategy: leveraging GA4 to cross-reference sales performance, identify conversion trends, and translate data insights into upselling, cross-selling, and merchandising strategies.
- Ecosystem stability: monitoring Shopify app integrations, resolving conflicts, building technical lead-capture forms, and optimizing navigation and checkout flow to eliminate user friction.

### Shopify Specialist / Senior Software Engineer — Virtustant
**August 2025 – Present · New York, NY, United States · Remote · Part-time**

Acting as the technical partner and sole engineer for an international luxury fashion brand. Owner of engineering, reliability, and scalability for their e-commerce ecosystem.

- Drove a +455% increase in platform sessions, +114% in orders, and +74% in total sales since joining through technical optimizations, SEO improvements, and marketing integrations.
- Designed and implemented custom frontend components and UI logic, heavily prioritizing performance, Core Web Vitals, and UX across a large-scale product catalog.
- Led and maintained critical platform integrations: Amazon Seller Central, Google Merchant Center, Meta Ads (CAPI / Pixel).
- Built and maintained robust automation workflows for marketing, inventory management, and post-purchase operations using Klaviyo, custom flows, and AI-assisted content pipelines.
- Served as primary technical decision-maker, balancing platform constraints, scalability, and business priorities in a fully remote, international environment.

### Founder — NEX Agency
**September 2020 – Present · São Paulo, Brazil · Remote · Self-employed**

Founded a software engineering consultancy serving clients across 10+ countries — software development, performance marketing, UI/UX design, and branding.

- Led technical architecture and full-stack development for clients in the US, Canada, France, Portugal, and Brazil — sole engineer and technical decision-maker.

Portfolio: https://nexagency.com.br

Strengthened the ability to build products from zero, wear every hat, and make engineering and business decisions with direct, measurable impact.

- **Bilingual.** Native Portuguese, fluent English. Comfortable in both written async work and live calls.
